recommendation_summary: Set up a hosted heartbeat monitor such as Healthchecks.io, with a wrapper around the Python script that pings start, success and failure, so the user gets an email if `nightly-sync` fails or misses its deadline after 03:00.
note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert and sets aside central logs, Synology and Docker as not solving the problem, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
